title: Integration test: remote pinning job enqueued after article ingest
description:
What: Integration test that exercises the full flow: configure external service, ingest article via pipeline, verify remote_pin_jobs row is inserted with status 'pending'.

Algorithm:
1. In crates/transit/tests/ (or existing transit test files), add test:
   - Use an in-memory SQLite pool with the new remote_pin_jobs migration
   - Configure a fake external service (no actual HTTP calls needed for this test)
   - Call run_pipeline() with test article bytes
   - After pipeline returns Ok, call the enqueue function (extracted from main.rs wire-in)
   - Query remote_pin_jobs: assert 1 row with status='pending', correct cid, correct service_name

2. Separate test for group filtering:
   - Configure service with groups=['comp.*']
   - Ingest article to 'comp.lang.rust' group -> assert row inserted
   - Ingest article to 'alt.test' group -> assert NO row inserted

3. Test for admin endpoint:
   - Insert some rows into remote_pin_jobs with various statuses
   - Call build_remote_pin_status_json()
   - Verify JSON output has correct counts

Defensive programming:
- Use in-memory DB (not files) for test isolation
- Do not make actual HTTP calls in this test
- Each test uses a unique in-memory DB name to prevent cross-test interference
